----Respondents
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Rajendra Charan
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Hanuman Prajapati, P. P.
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Maneesh Sharma
Order 03/12/2025
1.

The present criminal misc. petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.267/2025 registered at Police Station Subhashnagar, District Bhilwara for the offences under Sections 406, 420 & 120-B of IPC.
2.

During the course of arguments, on the basis of factual report dated 02.12.2025, learned Public Prosecutor informs this Court that the Investigating Officer engaged in the case has not found any offence made out against the petitioner, and accordingly a negative Final Report No.326/2025 dated 11.11.2025 has been submitted in the matter.
3. The factual report dated 02.12.2025 is taken on record.

(Uploaded on 04/12/2025 at 11:07:37 AM) [2025:RJ-JD:52022] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-6077/2025]
4. In view of the aforesaid, nothing remains to be adjudicated in the present petition.
5. Accordingly, the present criminal misc. petition is dismissed as having been rendered infructuous.
